description: Seed evaluation dataset for Nexus AI retrieval. Small by design (Milestone 3 baseline); expanded to 100-200 examples in Milestone 6. Each document is synthetic plain text. Each question's `relevant_doc` + `relevant_substring` identify the chunk that should be retrieved.

documents.text:
Nexus Corp Employee Handbook.

Annual Leave: Full-time employees are entitled to 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave does not carry over beyond March 31 of the following year.

Sick Leave: Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave annually. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than three consecutive days.

Remote Work: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Core collaboration hours are 10am to 3pm local time.

Expense Reimbursement: Business expenses must be submitted within 30 days with receipts. Reimbursement is processed within two payroll cycles.

Nexus Corp Information Security Policy.

Passwords: Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include letters, numbers, and symbols. Passwords expire every 90 days.

Multi-Factor Authentication: MFA is mandatory for all systems that access customer data.

Data Classification: Data is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted. Restricted data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.

Incident Reporting: Suspected security incidents must be reported to the security team within one hour of discovery.

Nexus Analytics Product FAQ.

Data Retention: Analytics data is retained for 24 months by default. Enterprise customers can configure retention up to 7 years.

Integrations: The platform integrates with Postgres, Snowflake, and BigQuery. A REST API is available for custom integrations.

Support: Standard support responds within 24 hours. Premium support offers a 2-hour response SLA and a dedicated account manager.

Pricing: Billing is per seat per month. Annual contracts receive a 15 percent discount.
